{"id":2011413149,"question_id":4312,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 4 weeks","timestamp":1779598995,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2011413149/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Limit Occurrences in Sorted Array","memory":"33.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> limitOccurrences(vector<int>& nums, int k) {\n        vector<int>ans;\n        ans.push_back(nums[0]);\n\n        int count = 1;\n        for(int i = 1 ; i<nums.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            if(nums[i] == nums[i-1])\n            {\n                count++;\n                if(count <= k) ans.push_back(nums[i]);\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                count = 1;\n                ans.push_back(nums[i]);\n            }\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"limit-occurrences-in-sorted-array","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2029}
